class.name: IfcTrapeziumProfileDef
class.brief_description: IfcTrapeziumProfileDef defines a trapezium as the profile definition used by the swept surface geometry or the swept area solid. It is given by its Top X and Bottom X extent and its Y extent as well as by the offset of the Top X extend, and placed within the 2D position coordinate system, established by the Position attribute. It is placed centric within the position coordinate system, that is, in

members.member: The extent of the bottom line measured along the implicit x-axis.
The extent of the top line measured along the implicit x-axis.
The extent of the distance between the parallel bottom and top lines measured along the implicit y-axis.
Offset from the beginning of the top line to the bottom line, measured along the implicit x-axis.
